title: Morning Brief — Monday, 14 September 2026
description: Today: proposed online-harm powers face pushback, mortgage rate competition heats up, and pensioners face health rebate cuts; Queensland investigates a residential-care assault case and coalmine security; and the Gold Coast deals with weekend traffic chaos and a hazard-reduction burn. Broadcast in English, followed by a full Korean-language version (호주, 퀵즐랜드, 그리고 골드코스트 소식을 전해드립니다).

show.channel_description: A short daily news brief covering Australian national news, Queensland, and the Gold Coast — made to listen to on the morning drive.
